title: Temporal hysteresis and per-shard recalibration for FP8 profile activation on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement temporal hysteresis and per-shard recalibration logic to prevent oscillation of FP8 profile activation (E4M3/E5M2) under workload drift. Scope: runtime gating rules, telemetry KPIs, micro-eval harness, canary orchestration, fallback to INT8 and full-precision guarded by SLOs. Goals: stabilize profile selection, reduce false-positive activations, ensure accuracy regression <0.5% on golden prompts, and keep latency within 1.15x baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Hysteresis window configurable per-workload and defaulted to 10 minutes
Per-shard recalibration completes within 45s on median and does not increase tail latency beyond 5%
Canary pipeline runs automated golden-run and passes accuracy/regression thresholds before full rollout
Automated fallback to INT8 triggers when cohort-wide accuracy drop >0.8% or error-rate increases 3x
Telemetry dashboard surfaces activation flips, per-shard drift metric, and time-to-stabilize
runbook: Step 1: Observe activation flips in Grafana panel 'FP8 Activation Flips'
Step 3: If golden-run fails, set profile.force_disable to true and escalate to oncall.quant (pager)
Step 4: Collect debug bundle and attach to ISSUE-ENG-302451 for postmortem
notes: Design decision: use exponential backoff + minimum hold time (configurable) rather than fixed cooldown to handle bursty traffic
Trade-off: longer hysteresis increases stability but delays beneficial activations for short-lived traffic spikes
Engineering note: prefer non-blocking per-shard recalibration using estimated scale-down slots to avoid eviction of active queries
